rows.text: Whether they are novice pickpockets or infamous master thieves, they always keep a few Goodluck Cookies in their pockets. These are dry, travel-friendly rations with a rather unappealing taste, rumored to be a recipe personally devised by their grandmaster, Zagreus. The ingredients are simple — just common ingredients like flour, butter, sugar, and salt — but if one happens to bite into the piece containing a hidden coin, they are said to receive the Titan's blessing. This might explain the cookie's odd texture and why so many thieves are missing a corner of a tooth, but who cares? As long as it brings good luck, it's worth the risk.
